name: scan-record-save-row-key-from-memory
body: ScanRecord::save derives its row key from the in-memory manifest, which a loaded record decodes empty because the field is serde-skipped, so saving a loaded record would key on the default manifest's root. Production recording passes the live manifest to put_scan, and every current save caller constructs a fresh record; upgrade when save takes an explicit worktree id or is retired.
